subject: Literature
title: Mahmoud Darwish and Palestinian Identity
description: One-minute skill: Mahmoud Darwish and Palestinian Identity.

hook.text: Mahmoud Darwish wrote poetry that became the unofficial anthem of an entire people fighting for their homeland.

buildup.text: His poem 'Identity Card' was recited at protests and demonstrations across the Arab world for decades.

discovery.text: Darwish was placed under house arrest by Israel multiple times simply for the power his poems held over audiences.

twist.text: Even some Israeli writers admired his craft, creating the paradox of enemies recognizing each other's literary genius.

climax.text: Darwish proved that poetry can carry the weight of national identity when politics fails a displaced people.

punchline.text: His verses gave a stateless people a literary homeland.

quiz.question: Why was Darwish placed under house arrest?
options: He committed violent acts of resistance
His poems held so much power over audiences that authorities feared their influence
